found.why: Shabbetotai = the Gemara's two Shabbatot = two aspects within every Shabbat (Zohar I 5b), so 'one Shabbat' (Yerushalmi) and 'two Shabbatot' agree; also cites mi-dei Shabbat b'Shabbato.
Berachto mikol hayamim = Shabbat's blessing comes from the six days according to one's service in them.
